title.rendered: PEB Structure Cost Per Sq Ft in India

content.rendered:
The PEB structure cost per sq ft in India typically runs between ₹300 and ₹600, with most mid-sized warehouses and factory sheds landing around ₹350 to ₹450 per sq ft for frame, cladding, roofing and basic fittings. That band is wide for one reason: a plain storage span and an insulated, wide-clear-span production building are priced as completely different structures. SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) prices each building to your drawing, so use the figure below to plan and ask us for a quote against your actual span.

Below is the full breakdown of where that per-sq-ft number comes from, how span width changes it, and how single-slope versus double-slope and clear-span versus multi-span decisions move the cost. SAMAN designs, fabricates and erects under one roof, with a 15-year-plus track record since 2009 (incorporated 2019).

Cost per sq ft breakdown

A PEB per-sq-ft rate is the sum of separately priced parts. Reading a quote by these parts is the only way to compare two suppliers fairly:

  • Structure (steel frame): usually the largest share — columns, rafters, purlins in IS 2062 steel. Driven by span, height and load.
  • Roofing: bare galvanised sheet is cheapest; colour-coated or insulated sandwich panels cost more but control heat and leaks.
  • Wall cladding: sheet, masonry up to sill with sheet above, or full insulated panel — each at a different rate.
  • Foundation: RCC footings and plinth, priced to your soil and column loads (often a separate civil line).
  • Erection: cranes, bolting and alignment crews — included in supply-and-erect, excluded in supply-only.
  • Finishing: gutters, downpipes, ridge vents, doors, windows, turbo-ventilators.

How span width changes cost per sq ft

Span — the column-free width — is the strongest single driver of the per-sq-ft rate. A wider clear span needs deeper, heavier rafters and stronger columns to carry the same roof, so steel weight per sq ft rises with span. A 12–15 m span building is cheaper per sq ft than a 30 m clear-span building covering the same floor area, because the wider one simply uses more steel overhead.

The practical takeaway: only buy the clear span you need. If your racking or machinery allows an intermediate column line, a multi-span layout often lowers the per-sq-ft cost without affecting how you use the floor.

Single vs double slope, clear span vs multi-span

Two design choices visibly move the rate:

  • Single slope (mono-pitch): common for narrower buildings or where you want drainage to one side; simple and economical.
  • Double slope (gable): the default for wider buildings; balances steel use across the span.
  • Clear span: no internal columns — maximum free floor, highest steel weight per sq ft.
  • Multi-span: one or more internal column lines — lower steel weight and lower per-sq-ft cost, at the cost of a few columns inside.

There is no single "right" answer — the cheapest building per sq ft is the one matched to how you actually use the floor.

FAQs: PEB structure cost per sq ft in India

What is the PEB structure cost per sq ft in India?
Roughly ₹300 to ₹600 per sq ft for frame, cladding, roofing and basic fittings, with most warehouses around ₹350 to ₹450. The exact figure depends on span, height, insulation and erection scope.

Why is a wider clear span more expensive per sq ft?
A wider column-free span needs heavier rafters and columns to carry the same roof, so steel weight per sq ft rises. A multi-span layout with an internal column line usually costs less.

What is not included in a per-sq-ft PEB rate?
Land, utilities, site levelling, complex interiors and sometimes the RCC foundation are usually separate. Always check what the rate covers.

Does insulation change the cost much?
Yes. Insulated sandwich-panel roofing and walls cost more than bare galvanised sheet but control heat and condensation — worth it for production, cold storage or office areas.

Single slope or double slope — which is cheaper?
Single slope is economical for narrower buildings; double slope is the norm for wider spans. The saving is small next to span and cladding choices.

What warranty applies to a SAMAN PEB structure?
5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.

How long does a PEB structure take to build?
Lead time depends on size, span and customisation. Share your drawing and we confirm a schedule after design sign-off.
